tldr: The U.S. economy unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July, contrary to projections of an increase.
Meta was ordered to pay an additional $567 million in a New Mexico child safety case, bringing total charges to nearly $1 billion.
Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan signed a defense pact, asserting that an attack on one country would be considered an attack on all.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both declined after the U.S. economy unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July, rather than the projected increase of 83,000 nonfarm payrolls.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield increased as investors reportedly demanded higher rates for long-duration bonds, citing decreased demand, higher supply, and policy uncertainty.

vix.why: The provided articles do not offer a specific reason for the VIX's decrease.

policy.what_happened: This bill amends the income tax rate provisions.
policy.effect: Your individual income tax rate is amended.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: AMD acquired Taalas, an AI chip startup, to enhance its compute solutions for the rapidly expanding AI inference market by etching models directly into silicon.

Anthropic, a leading AI company, announced plans to establish an in-house silicon team, indicating its intention to design its own hardware to power its Claude AI models and reduce reliance on external suppliers.
China has opened its first school dedicated to robots, with the primary objective being to empower and advance the capabilities of robot brains.

world.summary: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan signed a defense pact, with Pakistan stating that an attack on any of the three nations would be considered an attack against all, amid ongoing regional turmoil.

Tensions between the U.S. and Iran remain high, with reports suggesting Iran aims to ban U.S. and Israeli vessels from the Strait of Hormuz, while some analysts believe Tehran is intentionally prolonging conflict to influence U.S. midterm elections.

Houthi attacks on government forces and recent strikes in Yemen suggest a major battle may be imminent, as tensions between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia have escalated since the US-Israel conflict with Iran began.
